features.name: Microsoft Copilot Chat in Business Central
features.description: Microsoft Copilot built directly into Business Central, providing AI-powered chat assistance for various business scenarios and data analysis.

features.name: Sales tax configuration assistance
features.description: Copilot pulls data from the internet and provides guidance for setting up sales tax for different states, such as Oregon, accounting for state-specific tax rates.
caveats: requires internet connectivity to pull external data

features.name: Sales data analysis with Copilot
features.description: Copilot analyzes Business Central sales data to identify items that sold the least in the last 3 months, providing data-driven insights for inventory and sales management.
caveats: reasoning over data may take longer to process

features.name: Copilot recommendations for sales improvement
features.description: Copilot provides actionable suggestions to improve sales of underperforming items, such as bundling items, promoting color variants, and cross-selling strategies.

features.name: Calendar integration for meeting preparation
features.description: Copilot accesses the user's calendar to identify customer meetings and help prepare for them with Business Central data.

features.name: Sales brief generation
features.description: Copilot generates a comprehensive sales brief for customer meetings, including sales figures, sales momentum, account risk assessment, and recommended talking points.

features.name: General knowledge and directions assistance
features.description: Copilot provides general knowledge assistance beyond Business Central, including directions and travel guidance, helping users with logistics outside of core business data.
caveats: functionality extends beyond Business Central scope

quotes.text: Business Central has new Copilot chat, uh Microsoft Copilot built directly in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that Copilot is now a built-in feature of Business Central, not an external add-on.

quotes.text: Copilot pulls data from the internet and from various other sources and provides all the answers I need.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that Copilot combines internal Business Central data with external internet sources for comprehensive answers.

quotes.text: We are looking for items that sold uh the least in the last 3 months.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows Copilot's ability to perform time-bound sales analysis on Business Central data.

quotes.text: Copilot provided me the answers true to my question. Specifically, probably the Rome guest chair uh and maybe Sydney swivel chair.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates Copilot's ability to identify specific underperforming products from Business Central inventory.

quotes.text: Copilot is now accessing my uh calendar and finding a meeting with my customer.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows integration with external calendar systems to enable context-aware customer meeting preparation.

quotes.text: Copilot prepared a sales brief with some additional sales figures and information I need for the meeting.
quotes.why_it_matters: Illustrates Copilot's ability to synthesize Business Central data into actionable sales intelligence for customer interactions.
